description: A compact inline filter over mutually exclusive options. A real radio group, never a tab list, and it carries no crimson.

options.description: The options, in order. Two to four with one-word labels.

value.description: The selected option's value. Omit and pass `defaultValue` to let it govern itself.

defaultValue.description: The initially selected value when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first option.

ariaLabel.description: Names what is being filtered: "Time range", not "Filter". A radio group with no accessible name is announced unlabelled.

name.description: Shared name for the underlying radios; generated when omitted.

change.description: A different option was chosen; carries its value.
